title: Curve Dental Appoints Nat Harrison as SVP of Marketing
html:
Growth leader joins as Curve advances its $200 million R&D commitment and builds the platform dental practices won’t outgrow.

Curve Dental, the leader in AI-powered, cloud-native, all-in-one dental practice management software, has appointed Nat Harrison as senior vice president of marketing. An experienced entrepreneur and growth leader, Harrison joins as Curve expands its platform and strengthens the dental teams and practices that succeed with it.

Curve is bringing the work of dentistry together in one intelligent platform—connecting clinical care, patient engagement, payments, and practice operations. The company is backing that vision with a $200 million R&D commitment to expand native AI and integrated capabilities, alongside continued investment in implementation, training, and support.

“Dental practice owners should be able to build the businesses they envision, with technology that keeps pace with their ambitions,” said Dave Cormack, chairman and chief executive officer of Curve Dental. “We’re building the platform practices won’t outgrow, backed by a team they can count on. Nat combines entrepreneurial thinking with the discipline to build at scale. He will help us bring that vision to more practices.”

Harrison most recently served as vice president of B2B marketing at Mindbody, where he rebuilt the growth and product marketing functions to drive subscriber acquisition and platform adoption. Previously, he led acquisition and retention marketing for Wayfair Professional, helping scale Wayfair’s B2B business beyond $2 billion in revenue.

Earlier in his career, Harrison founded and led technology ventures and worked as a consultant at The Boston Consulting Group. He holds an MBA from the MIT Sloan School of Management and an AB from Harvard University.

“I know how much dental practice owners put into what they’re creating and how important it is to choose partners who deliver on their promises,” said Harrison. “What drew me to Curve is a team thinking boldly about the future of dentistry and investing to make it real. I’m excited to help more practices discover what they can accomplish with Curve and build the future they envision for their businesses.”

About Curve Dental

Curve Dental offers an AI-powered dental software platform built natively in the cloud. Its connected tools span practice management, clinical care, payments, revenue cycle management, and patient engagement, helping dental teams simplify daily work and grow their practices. Curve serves more than 6,000 practice locations in the United States and Canada. The privately held company operates from Alpharetta, Georgia; Provo, Utah; Calgary, Alberta; and Aberdeen, Scotland, and earned a 2026 USA TODAY Top Workplaces award. Learn more at www.curvedental.com or call 1-888-910-HERO.
